historical_significance: 霍去病（前140—前117），字少傅将軍將，西汉代伟大的騎都尉。他自幼随軍從戎，隨 uncle 衛青征西北，屢立戰功。前126年，隨衛青北伐，單騎入陣，斬首數級，獲封關內侯。前121年，領精騎800人深入匈奴腹地，擊匈奴军萬餘人，斬首五級以上，獲封萬戶侯。後來多次北伐，先後擊敗匈奴軍，先後俘虜匈奴王、大將，並帶回大量戰利品。他的勝利確保了河西走廊，擴大了漢朝對西域的控制。他被提升為大司馬，成為史上最年小時任此職的大將。前117年，年僅23歲的他去世， possibly 因 illness 或 primitive biological warfare。他的遺傳作為中國最偉大的軍事家之一被銘記，慶祝他的聰明、敢於和戰例不敗的戰役記錄。
historical_significance_en: Huo Qubing (140-117 BCE), courtesy name ? was a renowned Han dynasty military general. He began campaigning under his uncle Wei Qing from a young age, distinguished himself by leading a bold vanguard raid into Xiongnu territory, and was enfeoffed as Marquess of Guanjun (Champion) for his feat of slaying the Chanyu's grandfather and over 2,000 enemy troops with only 800 light cavalry. In 121 BCE, he led 800 elite cavalry deep into Xiongnu heartland, slaying over 10,000 enemies and capturing numerous nobles and the Golden Man idol. His subsequent campaigns repeatedly defeated Xiongnu forces, seized their kings and high leaders, secured the Hexi Corridor, and expanded Han control into the Western Regions. Promoted to Minister of War—the youngest ever—he died at age 23 in 117 BCE, possibly from illness or biological warfare. Remembered as one of China's greatest military strategists, celebrated for his brilliance, audacity, and undefeated battle record.

cross_references.description_en: Huo Qubing followed Wei Qing on northwestern campaigns, distinguished himself, serving as a vanguard under his uncle.

cross_references.relation_type: 民本思想对比：水舟論的不同侧重
cross_references.description_zh: 霍去病从具体军事胜利角度阐述水舟论，强调兵力机动的实际效果；刘秀从宏观历史周期角度阐述，强调民心向背对王朝更替的决定性作用。
cross_references.description_en: Huo Qubing elucidates the 'water-boat theory' from the perspective of concrete military victory, emphasizing the practical effect of troop maneuvering; Liu Xiu from a historical cycle perspective, emphasizing the decisive role of popular sentiment in dynastic transition.
